mapper.sql: SELECT r.report_id AS reportId, r.target_type AS targetType, r.target_id AS targetId, CASE r.target_type WHEN '기업' THEN c.company_name WHEN '채용공고' THEN jp.title WHEN '기업리뷰' THEN cr.summary WHEN '면접후기' THEN COALESCE(irjp.title, '면접후기') END AS targetName, r.reason_code AS reasonCode, r.detail, CONCAT(LEFT(u.name, 1), '**') AS reporterName, r.status, r.resolution_action AS resolutionAction, r.resolution_note AS resolutionNote, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.handled_at AS handledAt FROM reports r JOIN users u ON u.user_id = r.reporter_user_id LEFT JOIN companies c ON r.target_type = '기업' AND c.company_id = r.target_id LEFT JOIN job_postings jp ON r.target_type = '채용공고' AND jp.job_posting_id = r.target_id LEFT JOIN company_reviews cr ON r.target_type = '기업리뷰' AND cr.company_review_id = r.target_id LEFT JOIN interview_reviews ir ON r.target_type = '면접후기' AND ir.interview_review_id = r.target_id LEFT JOIN job_postings irjp ON irjp.job_posting_id = ir.job_posting_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(status = '미처리'), 0) AS pendingCount, COALESCE(SUM(status = '처리완료'), 0) AS completedCount, COALESCE(SUM(status = '기각'), 0) AS rejectedCount FROM () reports WHERE
SELECT reports.* FROM () reports WHERE reportId = #{reportId}
mapper.update: UPDATE reports SET status='기각', resolution_action='없음', resolution_note=#{memo}, handled_by=#{adminId}, handled_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE report_id=#{reportId} AND status='미처리'

UPDATE reports SET status='처리완료', resolution_action='숨김', resolution_note=#{memo}, handled_by=#{adminId}, handled_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE target_type=#{targetType} AND target_id=#{targetId} AND status='미처리'
UPDATE companies SET company_status='이용정지' WHERE company_id=#{targetId} AND company_status='정상'
UPDATE job_postings SET status='숨김', hidden_reason=#{memo}, hidden_by=#{adminId}, hidden_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE job_posting_id=#{targetId} AND status != '삭제'
UPDATE company_reviews SET status='숨김', hidden_reason=#{memo}, hidden_by=#{adminId}, admin_memo=#{memo} WHERE company_review_id=#{targetId} AND status != '삭제'
UPDATE interview_reviews SET status='숨김', hidden_reason=#{memo}, hidden_by=#{adminId}, admin_memo=#{memo} WHERE interview_review_id=#{targetId} AND status != '삭제'
